Edit only specs/. Use /speckit-specify, /speckit-clarify, /speckit-plan,
/speckit-checklist, /speckit-tasks, /speckit-analyze. No src/ changes.
Constitution amendments and external commands are human actions.
Instructions are not path isolation; all generated changes require the PR gates.
